IGUI_TienAttachmentPositions_Note: Every item you hang in this slot moves with it, whatever its kind. Changes show only on your screen until you press Save; then every player sees them on you. Reset goes back to where the game hangs things and Restore to your last save; neither saves by itself. Hold Shift on the slider arrows for bigger steps.
IGUI_TienAttachmentPositions_ResetTip: Back to where the game hangs things. Not saved until you press Save.
IGUI_TienAttachmentPositions_RestoreTip: Back to what you last saved for this slot.
IGUI_TienAttachmentPositions_ResetAllTip: Put every slot back where the game hangs things. Asks first, then saves at once.
IGUI_TienAttachmentPositions_ResetAllAsk: Put every slot back where the game hangs things? This is saved at once, and every player sees it.
IGUI_TienAttachmentPositions_CloseAsk: This slot has changes you have not saved. Save them before closing?
IGUI_TienAttachmentPositions_Clothing: This spot is hidden by some clothing, and moving it would stop that, so it stays where it is.
IGUI_TienAttachmentPositions_NoPoint: Your character's model has no point for this spot, so there is nothing to move.
